collections.title: The Heritage Christmas Edit
collections.headline: Velvet, tartan and candlelight, gathered the way a house remembers it
collections.intro: This is the Christmas a house inherits: deep green velvet, tartan wool, brass and candlelight, arranged around an evergreen mantel. Every piece is chosen to look collected over decades rather than bought in one season.
collections.art_note: Living room at dusk, low warm lamp and candle glow, cream velvet seating, deep green tartan wool throw across the arm, cedar garland along a dark wood mantel, brass hurricane holders, one brass bell at the door, evergreen and burgundy palette, natural light fading, linen and wool textures, real lived-in room, no people, no text.

collections.title: The Thanksgiving Hosting Edit
collections.headline: The table is set before the first guest knocks
collections.intro: Thanksgiving is won in the hour before anyone sits down: the platter that fits the bird, the board that keeps people out of the kitchen, the candles that make a buffet look deliberate. Nothing here is themed, which is why it all still works on a Tuesday.
collections.art_note: A hosted Thanksgiving table at warm golden hour, camera slightly above and to the side, looking along a cream linen cloth: an acacia charcuterie board with aged cheese, dark grapes and rosemary, a hand woven rattan bread basket lined with linen, a large oval cream platter with two plain side plates, a cream and deep green glazed ceramic pumpkin dish, three lit ivory tapers in dark wood candlesticks, two amber glass votives, a hurricane glass holder, a pale green pressed glass tumbler, folded cream napkins in carved acacia rings, antique brass flatware. Cream, amber, acacia, sage and terracotta in raking afternoon light, no people, no text.

collections.title: The Moody Tablescape Edit

collections.intro: A moody table is built from the shadows up: near black pumpkins, burgundy linen, smoked amber glass and candlelight held low so the food still reads warm. Almost nothing here is bright, and that is the point of it.
